thread.title: Apple won't follow Amazon's bidding war approach to choosing new campus, rules out Texas

author: wn.com
title: Apple won't follow Amazon's bidding war approach to choosing new campus, rules out Texas
text: Apple Inc. (Nasdaq: AAPL) wants to create a new corporate campus that will house thousands of employees, but it won't follow Amazon.com's highly public approach to finding a city to host its second outpost, according to media reports. According to the news agency, Apple won't hold a bidding process for its new campus.
